title: Ships
description: Ship types of a region (CONTENT §8, MECHANICS §9). Ships are ordered at buildings with a shipyard block that lists them.

slots.description: Number of cargo slots; a slot holds one good.

slot_size.description: Capacity of one cargo slot in units.

speed.description: Speed factor (1.0 = reference speed, region rule ship_speed_tiles_per_min).

cost.description: Order cost: 'gold' plus materials by good ID (units), deducted at order time.

length_tiles.description: Hull length in tiles at model scale (display only: the client draws ships and spaces the Trading Post berths by it, CONTENT §11). Absent: the reference length 2.
